reason: A DeepSeek Harness starter pack that automates selecting, installing, and configuring curated community plugins through settings or slash commands.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可选插件分组的一键安装与配置功能。
summaries.en: Provides one-click selection, installation, and configuration of curated plugin groups for DeepSeek Harness.

capabilities: Installs a selected batch of community plugins
Reinvokes the dsh command through child_process
Writes plugin configuration patches to the profile
Modifies pnpm workspace build permissions when installation is blocked
